RESULT: DONE
CHANGED: src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_work_list.py, src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_work_get.py, tests/integration/test_mindmap_work_list_get_e2e.py, src/mem_mcp/mindmap/work_items.py
TESTS: pytest tests/integration/test_mindmap_work_list_get_e2e.py tests/unit/test_work_items_service.py tests/integration/test_mindmap_work_items_e2e.py -q -> 71 passed in 10.03s; ruff check src tests -> All checks passed!; mypy -> Success: no issues found in 364 source files
CHECKLIST:
#1 FIXED mindmap_work_list.py: input now takes status, kind, assignee_id, unassigned, map_state and limit (1..500, default 100), passed to the service. A ValueError from the service maps to -32602. There is no offset because the service has none, so a map with more than 500 items still can't be fully paged.
#2 FIXED mindmap_work_get.py `summarize_moves`: item-level `blocked_reason` is now set only when no move is takable. A move with no blocker, or only `reason_required`, counts as takable. When blocked, it reports the first of "awaiting N sign-offs", `role_restricted`, `no_transition`, in that order. `pending_signoff` is the first pending request. The model holds a single value, so a second pending request is still not shown, and the rule is documented in code.
#3 FIXED test file: new workflow e2e test covers `reason_required`, `no_transition`, a pending sign-off and an item-level `blocked_reason` of "awaiting 2 sign-offs". It checks that `pending_signoff` is populated and that list and get agree. A direct `summarize_moves` test covers `role_restricted`, `no_transition`, a takable move and empty moves.
#4 FIXED test file: added `get` with an unknown `map_key` (-32602), a second work item, a `kind` filter, `limit`, a status filter returning nothing, the mutually exclusive filters (-32602), and an explicit `team_id`.
#5 NOT FIXED `compute_item_moves` lives in workflow_reads.py, which isn't mine. It re-resolves the root, role and workflow on every call, so list still runs it once per item. The new `limit` bounds that cost. A batch variant in workflow_reads.py would remove it, and that's a follow-up for WP3.
NOTES:
- I made a one-line change in src/mem_mcp/mindmap/work_items.py. `list_work_items` never set `workflow_id` or `current_stage`, so list reported `status` (`todo`) instead of the real workflow stage. The new test caught it.
- No test covers a viewer-role caller with a role-restricted item at the tool level, because a viewer from another tenant can't see the owner's items. That path is only covered by the direct `summarize_moves` test.
- I ran `alembic upgrade head` because the test DB didn't have the `work_items` table yet.
